changes: Added Motedis as a second supplier, covering eleven I-type T-slot nuts for slot 5, 6 and 8 aluminium profiles — a range Bossard does not serve well
New part type: T-slot nut, sized by profile slot first and thread second, since an M5 nut for a slot 6 profile does not fit a slot 8 one
The part assigner now asks which supplier first whenever more than one sells the kind of part you are placing, and skips the question when only one does
Order List shows which supplier each part comes from, and exports one CSV per supplier
Fixed: assigning an o-ring, spring or spacer to a bin dropped its dimensions, so the label printed without a size and the suggested order quantity was far too high
Parts are no longer limited to fasteners — o-rings, springs and spacers are supported alongside screws, nuts, washers and the rest
Catalogs from more than one supplier can now be used side by side: the part assigner asks which supplier first, and the Data Manager remembers a preferred one
Order List gained a Supplier column, and its CSV export now writes one file per supplier, since an order goes to one vendor at a time
Fixed: part drawings for M12 and larger, for sizes below M2, and for every pin diameter were all drawn at M3 size on labels and on the bin poster
Fixed: “Jump to drawer” from the Setup view did nothing
Saved configs now record which supplier a part came from. Files saved with earlier versions keep working unchanged
Reorganized navigation into labeled groups: Configure, Generate, Stock
New splash screen with quick-access cards
Import & Export moved to dedicated Data Manager
Fixed dark-mode text colour on buttons and label sheet headers
Added fixed footer with version, help, source, and theme toggle
Placeholder sections: Bin Models (Generate) and Order (Stock)
